sentences.text: Researchers focused on halting amyloid deposits caused by alpha-synuclein aggregation in Parkinson's disease by creating virtual molecules and testing purchasable versions in the lab.

One compound slowed alpha-synuclein aggregation specifically when secondary nucleation was the primary driver, suggesting this computational approach is useful for identifying new protein aggregation inhibitors.
